description: Vision of Voodress: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Good news, friend. Molthor be singin' your praises lately. He say how you be turnin' into a real hero of Zandalar.
He also say for Maywiki to polish your orb some more! Give it here so Maywiki can brighten the vision.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Beware the evil Hakkari spirits, mon. Honestly, they be spooky.
